candidate.definition_en: Able to be done or achieved; that may exist or happen.
candidate.explanation_ar: يعني حاجة ممكن تحصل أو تقدر تعملها، مش مستحيلة.

senses.definition_en: Able to be done or achieved; that may exist or happen.
senses.explanation_ar: يعني حاجة ممكن تحصل أو تقدر تعملها، مش مستحيلة.
examples: Is it possible to walk there?
Please come as soon as possible.
It is possible that it will rain tomorrow.
Is it possible to walk there?

candidate.mnemonic: كلمة 'Possible' فيها 'Pass'.. يعني الامتحان ده ممكن تنجح وتعمل فيه 'Pass' لأنه 'Possible'.
